result: pass as a qualified bounded instrument result
headline: Gate 6 passes as a qualified instrument result: local views preserve their sources and dependencies, and a repaired summary supports the declared receiving task. The initial compact summary fails that task. The graph and plain table use the same measured navigation actions; human understanding and a general geometry advantage remain untested.
authority: Actual Gate 6 approval only. Gate 7 remains unapproved. This synthesis is not approval.

evidenceBoundary.note: Subsequent presentation/handoff evidence and final gate freeze are separate host records.

cases.case: C1 · Reference and scale round trips
cases.expected: Capacity→access→capacity changes Hall and Studio; expansion preserves the local account.
cases.observed: Actual reference switch/back and Field expand/collapse/re-expand restore exact fingerprints. Field remains yes; weather remains unmapped. All four Gate 2 records and histories stay unchanged.
cases.interpretation: The declared views reorganize and recover the same evidence.
cases.unresolved: These mappings do not establish agreement or understanding.

cases.expected: The initial summaries cannot answer the receiver. Repair reveals Hall 6 versus Field 9 against budget 8.
cases.observed: Both v1 payloads return insufficient-summary. Hall hire 4 + ramp 2 = 6; Field hire 3 + generator 3 + shelter 3 = 9. v2 gives Hall numeric pass and Field budget fail.
cases.interpretation: The compression fails this task; explicit dependency/cost repair makes this narrow screen answerable.
cases.unresolved: Availability, bookings and full event feasibility remain unknown.

cases.expected: Receiver minimum 60 → 70 produces traced, attributed revisions without changing the capacity 60 reference.
cases.observed: Both venue capacity fields are traced to v3. Hall capacity pass changes true → false; Field stays true but over budget. Both now fail the numeric screen. Prior revisions and synthetic author remain inspectable.
cases.interpretation: The changed requirement reaches the relevant local evidence and outward revisions.
cases.unresolved: A fixture editor attribution is not a human decision or endorsement.

cases.expected: Keep capacity and existing-access questions, authors and mappings separately.
cases.observed: Both original definitions and complete tables remain available. Hall retains its capacity reference; Field retains existing access as its local reference.
cases.interpretation: Competing questions remain explicit through larger-view changes.
cases.unresolved: No averaging, consensus or social coordination was tested.

cases.expected: An unsupported transfer stays outside the supported graph; close placement changes layout only.
cases.observed: Claim evidence is empty. Four supported relations stay intact, including shared weather source; the claimed transfer is excluded from receiver computation. Close placement preserves semantic hashes.
cases.interpretation: Inspection distinguishes a shared source from an unsupported transfer.
cases.unresolved: A line or proximity establishes no resource transfer, influence or authority.

cases.expected: Identical sources, rules, correction operations and starting semantic state.
cases.observed: Both modes: N1 three navigation actions plus one repair; N2 two navigation actions. All four endpoints pass.
cases.interpretation: The implemented routes are equivalent in counted actions and information.
cases.unresolved: No measured geometry advantage, optimal-route or human-effort claim.

cases.expected: 30-second discrete replay; seven repeatable checkpoints; historical artifacts unchanged.
cases.observed: Natural automatic end at 30 s; pause/step/scrub work. Seven hashes match at baseline, restore, reopen and reload. All 668 prior frozen entries match.
cases.interpretation: The exact tested local run is reproducible in this browser/build.
cases.unresolved: Pixel identity across devices and OS reduced-motion behavior were not tested.
